column1: # GE-T10's fourth question set (SMYSL-2.5 OQ-22's owed intent vocabulary): sixteen questions,
# two per intent, each asked in the five tier-1 languages, eighty rows, over the committed
# corpus (`../gold/corpus.smy`). Only the front is scored on it, as on `../third/`.
# WHY A FOURTH SET. The third set found openers the intent table does not write. A rule written
# from those questions and scored on them is scored in-sample, so the rules were fixed first —
# listed here, exactly, before a word of this set was written — and are scored on this set,
# whose front was taken before the code changed (`baseline.txt`). No rule is added or changed
# after a run of this set; a miss it finds is owed to a fifth.
# THE RULES, DECLARED (from the third set's losses only):
#   6. a definition asked in the past or with "exactly":
#        en  what exactly is / what exactly was / who exactly is / who exactly was
#        de  was war / was genau ist / was genau war / wer genau ist / wer genau war
#        es  quién fue / quien fue / qué era / que era / qué fue / qué era exactamente /
#        fr  qu'était / qu'était exactement / qui était exactement
#        ru  кем был / кем была / кем были
#   7. a verification asked as whether there is evidence:
#        en  is there any evidence that / is there proof that
#        de  gibt es belege dass / gibt es belege dafür dass / gibt es beweise dass /
#        es  hay pruebas de que / hay evidencia de que
#        fr  y a-t-il des preuves que / y a-t-il des preuves qu'
#        ru  есть ли доказательства что / есть ли доказательства того что
#   8. a location asked with "mention" as the verb:
#        en  where do the texts mention / where do the sources mention
#        es  dónde se menciona / donde se menciona / dónde se menciona a / dónde se mencionan
# WHO WROTE THIS. The same hand that declared the rules, after declaring them, so it knew them;
# the questions are written as a person would ask, and half of them reach for an opener none of
# the rules writes (a different adverb, another noun for evidence, another verb for mention,
# another intent's idiom), which is expected to fail. Nothing was rephrased after a run. Single
# Columns as `../gold/questions.tsv`: qid, intent, lang, question.
